API, MCP, music, appearance and voice/image settings: original forms, pickers, presets, requests, media, imports/exports, persistence and errors.

Chat navigation and settings: room/list/settings state, controls, accordion, reply/voice/opening preferences, wallpaper/font/bubble CSS, world bindings and identity/barcode.

Composer and reply triggers: React textarea/send/moon handlers, draft persistence, automatic delay/queue/flush and original send behavior.
Voice: recording/MIME/limits/cancel/release, playback, WAV conversion, transcription, translation, synthesis, result UI and request/error/abort behavior.
Reply engine: context/world constraints, API requests, segments/quotes/voice/recall/presence/typing, current/background replies and notification completion.
History: refs own active key/history/times/counts/restore state, original HTML storage/backup compatibility, avatar stripping, previews, background/recall/forward and role switching.

completed_behavior_history: settings home state, section collapse, visitor count, avatar upload and About modal
electronic pet: hunger, happiness, sleep, pose, poop, animations, timers and persistence
splash: Win98 loader, daily/always/off preferences, ready delay and reveal animation
home pagination: tabs, mouse/touch swipes and ignored targets
home device status: clock, battery API, network API, simulations and listener cleanup
home notice: latest reply, character avatar fallback, unread total, age and persistence
home player: simulated playback, seeking, favourites, notes, text persistence and avatar uploads
personal profile: native layout, counters, editable text, mood synchronisation, captions, notes, photos and persistence
background activity: settings, notification permission/sound/vibration, quiet audio, wake lock and lifecycle cleanup

API: controlled form, provider/model pickers, numeric filtering, defaults, persistence, connection tests, stats/logs, context trimming, feature models, OpenAI/Claude streaming and fallback requests
MCP: React service/modal/header/tool state, transports, modern and legacy tools discovery, permission persistence, description generation through React API service, shared choice modal
Music: native playlist, URL/local files, IndexedDB blobs, replacements, cover compression, editing, drag ghost/reordering, persistence, modes/autoplay/notes, media ref and React audio handlers

Appearance: native color/HEX/HSV modal, glass, splash preferences, wallpaper and opacity, fonts and IndexedDB restoration, custom icon drafts/save/reset, home text editing and music title synchronization

Voice/image: native tabs and controlled forms, provider presets/model fetch, choice context, local settings, password toggles, audio ref/player events, character prompt builder/editing, OpenAI/Grok/Moss/MiniMax/Gemini speech and OpenAI/Grok/Gemini/NovelAI images, zip image extraction
World: native books/entry forms, role bindings and advanced triggers, picker state, search/filter, cover compression, pointer drag sorting, JSON import/export, confirmations and persistence

Chat sidebar: React markup, avatar/name/presence input adapter, controlled personal presence menu, custom status, keyboard handling, viewport positioning and persistence; legacy Chat source bridge remains until parent migration

Native button press: shared React PressedButton/PressedDiv with state, original border detection and exclusions, class ordering, refs/events and pre-marked drag ghosts. Native behavior verified with legacy pointer delegate disabled. Legacy Chat buttons still use retained initializer until Chat migration.

Character PNG: React file controls/events and strict TypeScript private/portable/V3/V2 codecs, full-photo export and unknown-field preservation. Import commits directly into native React archive state and storage; remaining Chat list synchronization uses a temporary Chat service.

Character editor body: React profile/appearance/personality/speech/online-offline/network/favorites/memories/other/secret forms, tabs, tags and relationships. Native React archive state receives edits and preserves original 300ms draft persistence.

Character avatar/banner: React state, file events and refs; original 320px WebP .78, JPEG .78/browser and .62/large-payload fallbacks, failure handling and centered positions. Native archive storage with temporary Chat list/avatar synchronization service.

Character record switch menu: React state, selection events and refs; zoom-aware above/below positioning, original labels, rebuild/focus and close rules. Selection updates the native React archive owner.

Character dialog controls: React outer overlay/titlebar/banner/body/footer JSX, visibility, native backdrop capture and button events, synchronous empty-name validation focus. No legacy HTML host or legacy archive controller.

Character archive controller: React useState/useRef for records, current index, dialog refs and debounce timer; new/save/delete, IDs, stamp/date, draft filtering/restoration, strict TypeScript storage/readback, failure/retry and native PNG import. Native React character store owns list data; temporary retained Chat services handle avatar/history synchronization until Chat migration; shared confirmation UI is native React.

Chat search/list cards: native React input state/ref and onInput, All/Chats/Group state and React click events, empty-state visibility and filtering by trimmed locale-insensitive name/preview; native JSX list cards, draft/time/unread/favorite/pin state and 520ms/9px long-press React events. Rebuild versus preview-only search timing preserved. No chat-search runtime or ClassicScriptSlot; Native React character data and menu are complete; Chat room activation and preview/history synchronization retain temporary services; notifications and unread counts are native React.

Chat character action menu: React portal JSX, open/selection/position state and refs, original zoom-aware left/right/above/below clamping, labels/backdrop close and pin/favorite/delete button events; toggles and toasts use React logic, character storage/list/deletion are managed by the native React store; Chat room/history cleanup remains a temporary service. Shared Chat/archive confirmations use React state, independent Promise requests, native button/backdrop events and original default/custom labels. No legacy menu or confirmation HTML/listeners.

Chat character data: native React useState/useRef owner and typed synchronous read bridge; original deferred startup JSON load, strict TypeScript persistence/readback, archive upsert/identity/timestamp/flags, 320px image shrinking with smaller-image preference, failure rollback/retry, pin/favorite mutation behavior, stable pinned ordering, list/archive deletion and dossier storage cleanup. Remaining legacy Chat reads the React store; room avatar/history/draft synchronization and navigation are temporary services; unread counts are native React.

Reply notification and unread counts: native React portal content, visibility/reset state, button ref and onClick; native useRef frame/timer/current key, per-message slide reset and original 4500ms close; unread JSON loading/persistence/count mutation in React, per-message totals/minimum/99+ and failure behavior preserved. Home and system reply events are forwarded with original viewed/unknown-key rules. Temporary Chat navigation and thread-preview services remain.

Chat navigation: native React surfaces useState/useRef and typed navigation provider own app/list/room/settings/dock visibility, preserving class token order and pending legacy preference/selection classes. Dock Home/Chat, app/room/settings back and hidden activation button use React onClick; legacy navigation DOM mutations and corresponding listeners removed. Ordered recording/message/menu/draft/identity/preferences/scroll side effects remain explicit temporary Chat services until their migration; returning to list does not cancel automatic replies.

Chat settings accordion: seven native React sections with one expanded key in useState and direct onClick / aria-expanded / JSX classes; shared native PressedButton retains pointer appearance. Repeated clicks collapse the current section and opening another closes it; navigation, character switches and resetting preferences retain the current expanded section. Static panel children stay mounted and never rerender from accordion state, preserving pending legacy field, identity, world-book and style services. Legacy accordion DOM queries, class writes and click listeners removed. Settings field and persistence controllers remain pending.

Chat basic settings: native React controlled read-receipt / time display / typing / sound / vibration inputs, onChange and state/ref; original checked/default option attributes retained. Full preference defaults, normalization/load and save moved to strict TypeScript, preserving per-chat and legacy moon fallback, all ranges/enums/coercions, silent storage failures and non-strict primitive/array JSON store behavior. Pending legacy controls use typed preference services; current preference UI snapshots are held by the React provider. Feedback AudioContext is owned by native React useRef; sine oscillator, 480/610 Hz frequency, gain .0001/.045/.0001 at 0/.01/.09, duration .1s, send 12ms / receive [15,28,15] vibration, webkit fallback and silent error handling preserved. Remaining message style/identity rendering are temporary legacy services; unported controls still have temporary cached preference snapshots.

Chat reply settings: segmented/time-aware checkbox state, delay/context native range JSX/onInput, disabled row and value labels, reply-length/quote-policy select onChange, and model draft/ref with blur/Enter commit. Original static default attributes and select options retained, input-only draft timing and whitespace trim preserved; legacy control lookups, property/class writes and listeners removed. Typed preference provider drives native state and shared storage; remaining room appearance/identity application and voice toggles/voice engine stay pending.

Chat voice flags and opening: five native React checkbox controls with original save-only timing and AI voice readiness warning; textarea draft/state/ref/onInput with 800 UTF-16-unit persistence cap, only global preference application resets draft display. Opening empty-history predicate, reload-before-ensure, trim, ensure result and restart confirmation/clear/ensure/close/toast flow moved into native React controller. Native restart PressedButton and typed shared confirm dispatch; legacy control getters, writes, event bindings and opening decision/restart controller removed. A narrow retained Chat message adapter still checks existing rows, clears and renders/stamps/IDs/groups/scrolls an opening message until the message renderer/history is migrated. Actual recording/playback/transcription/translation remain pending.
聊天壁纸、本地 / 网络字体、字号、气泡 CSS 控件、资源存储、加载 / 校验 / 重置与原角色切换应用已迁到 React + TypeScript；聊天数据导入 / 导出仍通过 typed bridge 调用资产工具。
聊天数据导入 / 导出、清空当前记录、恢复当前设置已迁到 React onClick / onChange、ref 文件控件 / 下载链接与 TypeScript 流程；保留 v1 备份格式、确认 / 错误 / 部分失败顺序和字体 / 壁纸资源。消息 HTML 替换与整理暂接现有消息服务。
消息操作菜单 / 布局定位 / 长按计时 / 引用预览与清除、复制 / 兼容回退、收藏 / 置顶决策、编辑 / 删除 / 撤回弹窗及操作调度已迁 React state / ref / JSX；语音识别、翻译、消息行修改、标签与多选 / 转发渲染仍暂接显式服务。
置顶条显隐 / 内容 / 点击 / 闪烁计时与消息置顶 SVG 图标已迁到 React state / ref / JSX / portal；时间标记的挂载点仍由现有消息服务提供。发送者 / 时间和收藏 / 已编辑属性仍待消息行迁移，message-labels.runtime.js 尚未移除。
Forward target picker: React search, single/multiple target selection, recent persistence and room restoration; message-selection toolbar and record renderer remain legacy.

Message selection header/toolbar: native React JSX, visibility/count state and onClick, TypeScript copy/favorite/forward/delete action decisions; row selection and scroll anchoring remain explicit legacy services.

Forward record detail: native React state/JSX/back button and message-list onClick; TypeScript title/subtitle/date range, speaker/voice text and continued-avatar derivation. Record storage/card rendering and avatar lookup still explicit legacy services.

Forward records: React state/ref storage and synchronous read/create API, TypeScript record ID/title/subtitle/items construction, original persistence/failure behavior and array compatibility. Card HTML/message renderer remains legacy.

Message selection controller: React state/ref active mode/count, onClickCapture, 700ms per-row long-press lock and scroll anchor restoration; native room selection class. Legacy row class projection/grouping remains explicit service until message-row renderer migration.

Composer: native textarea/send button, React state/ref height/availability/draft text, onInput/onKeyDown/onClick; TypeScript per-role draft persistence/read/delete and input auto-reply delay adapter. Message creation/voice engine still explicit legacy services.

Reply triggers: native moon button busy/pending state and onClick, React refs own shared Promise queue and per-role automatic countdown/flush; TypeScript delay read/write. Actual AI requests and message rendering remain explicit legacy services.

AI reply parser: shared strict TypeScript extraction, JSON compatibility, per-segment quotes, voice/recall flags and presence; React lifecycle registers typed service; message DOM and API engine still pending

Chat sidebar: React markup, avatar/name/presence input adapter, controlled personal presence menu, custom status, keyboard handling, viewport positioning and persistence

Reply notification and unread counts: native React portal content, visibility/reset state, button ref and onClick

Chat basic settings: native React controlled read-receipt / time display / typing / sound / vibration inputs, onChange and state/ref

Native message frontend: React state/ref tree renders all rows, text/Markdown/voice bubbles, quotes, forward cards, avatars, grouping, standard and custom SVG, sender/time/favorite/edited labels, receipts and date/unread separators.

Native message mutations: edit/delete/recall, selection/class projection, pin/read metadata, transcript and translation results; React click/keyboard/audio events and ref timers preserve original interactions.
